title: Order of test execution not correct when selecting multiple suites against multi-asic DUTs
author: sanmalho-git

**Description**
Using run_tests.sh with '-O' option to maintain the order in which the tests are executed, the tests are not running in the order expected.

This changed with PR https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/5362
<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**


1. Run run_tests.sh with '-O' option and '--setup-plan' pytest option, and tests bgp/test_bgp_facts.py followed by voq/test_voq_init.py against the multi-asic KVM (testbed vms-kvm-four-asic-t1-lag) . using the following command in sonic-mgmt docker to get the order of the tests that would be executed
```
AzDevOps@4835ceaed434:/data/sonic-mgmt/tests$ ./run_tests.sh  -i ../ansible/veos_vtb -n vms-kvm-four-asic-t1-lag -f /data/sonic-mgmt/ansible/vtestbed.csv -k debug -u -a False -O -r -c "bgp/test_bgp_fact.py voq/test_voq_init.py" -p /tmp/ -e "--setup-plan" | grep -v SETUP | grep -v TEARDOWN | awk '{print $1}'
```


**Describe the results you received:**
With sonic-mgmt set to commit https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/commit/4321596c7c7b1554e2ae053ef74ac2652651a525 (for PR https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/5362), we see that bgp is run on asic0, then we run the voq_init tests against asic0, then we come and run bgp against asic1, and then the voq_init tests against asic1, then repeated for asic2 and then for asic3.

Summary:

Refactor macsec fixtures. It is a dynamic pytest plugin and only enabled with option `--enable_macsec`. It proceeds to be an improvement of https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/5362.
Fixes #5498.


### Type of change

<!--

- [x] Bug fix

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
To refine macsec fixtures to avoid any unnecessary dependency and overhead.
#### How did you do it?
Implement macsec fixtures in pytest plugin and only register it if the option `--enable_macsec` is specified.
